_about: archify is vendored as a skill (plugins/god-mode-core/skills/archify). Some of its tests check files of the upstream archify repository (READMEs, docs site, benchmarks, release manifests, .github) that are not shipped with the skill. scripts/test_archify.py runs every other test and fails if an entry below goes stale. 'needs' names the upstream path the test reads, relative to the archify repository root.

excluded_tests.name: checked-in Checkout compare artifact is reproducible from its authoritative inputs
skill and READMEs describe automatic port spread as bounded default behavior
cli: inspect emits architecture layout json
render rejects a mistyped option instead of writing a file named after it
render rejects an extra positional argument
tracked browsable HTML embeds well-formed XML SVG
legacy example URLs redirect to the current canonical artifacts
Skill, product docs, and READMEs keep the optional truthful boundary explicit
skill and READMEs describe the optional Export variant and show one real card without changing the hero
the skill and every README make the optional Share Card discoverable
skill description is portable across 1024-character runtimes and remains searchable
excluded_tests.reason: god-mode rewrites every skill description to 300 characters or fewer (scripts/validate.py), so the upstream description checks do not apply
